main_text.p: קוריא Chal. Ornamenta capitis virginum, Coronæ, קוריא דרהבא מן רישיהון Coronas aureas ex capitibus ipsarum, Num.31.48.in Targ.Hierofol. Scholiastes Hebraeus annotat, quòd sit תבשיטעשוי כרמות עיר ornamentum capitis factum ad similitudinem urbis, vel כי מצויר עליו כמין עיר quòd sit figurata seu acu picta in eo urbs aliqua. Derivat itaque à præcedenti קריא.
ܩܪܝܬܐ Syr. Pagus, Vicus, Oppidum, Marc. 8.23.26. Lucæ 19.30. Item Villa, Ager, Prædium, Lucæ 14.18. Act. 1.18.
ܩܪܝܬܐ Syr. Idem, Const. ܐܚܠܐ Ager sanguinis, Act.1.19. Affine est Græc. χωρίον & χωρίον. Plur.
ܩܪܝܬܐ Syriac.Kaura, insula,Act.27.16. Vide notas D. Tremellii.
קרח Hebr. Glabrare se, Calvitium sibi inducere. Hinc
קריח Chald. Idem, Levit.13.40. in Onk. Ionathan.habet קרוח.
קרחותא, קרחות Ch. Calvities, calvum, locus calvus aut decalvatus, Levit.13.42.in Onk.Jonath. קרוחתא.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several Syriac and Greek forms are partly illegible and the vowel points are reduced to what is visible. Marginal Hebrew near the foot (קרוח) is printed at the right and may be a catchword or signature.
